<function name="SetCanWalk" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Set if the player should be allowed to walk using the (default) alt key. (`+walk` keybind)</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="canWalk" type="boolean">`true` allows the player to walk.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
